enquete_introduction_message_html:
We would like to get to know you better to help you find the right study or career path.

This short survey consists of several questions about your interests, preferences, and goals. It takes approximately 5 minutes to complete. Your answers are treated confidentially and used only to provide better advice.

How does our AI model work?
Our system uses only your survey answers to find modules that match your interests. It looks at which subjects align with your preferences and generates a list of suggestions. For each module, we also briefly explain why it suits you.

Good luck!

how_to_register.question: How do I register for an elective module?
how_to_register.answer: You can register for an elective module via the Osiris system. Log in with your student credentials and navigate to the course registration section.

change_personal_settings.question: How can I change my personal settings?
change_personal_settings.answer: Go to the settings page by clicking on your profile and select 'Settings'. Here you can adjust your preferences, such as language, theme, and notifications.

forgot_password.question: What should I do if I forget my password?
forgot_password.answer: Click on the 'Forgot password?' link on the login page. Follow the instructions to reset your password via your registered email address.

contact_instructor.question: How can I contact the instructor of an elective module?
contact_instructor.answer: You can contact the instructor via Teams. Go to the module page and click on the contact link to send a message.
